rules.name: Order ID Uniqueness Check
rules.description: Ensures all order IDs in orders.csv are unique and no duplicates exist.

rules.name: Order Items Foreign Key Check
rules.description: Ensures all product_id references in order_items.csv exist in products.csv.

rules.name: Inventory Non-Negative Check
rules.description: Ensures inventory quantity on hand is never negative.

rules.name: Partition Freshness Check
rules.description: Detects missing transaction windows or ingestion delays exceeding SLA thresholds.

rules.name: Orders Mandatory Fields Check
rules.description: Verifies that essential order header fields contain no null or empty values.

rules.name: Product ID Uniqueness Check
rules.description: Ensures product catalog primary keys are unique.

rules.name: Product Base Price Positive Check
rules.description: Ensures base price of products is greater than zero.

rules.name: Inventory SKU Uniqueness Check
rules.description: Ensures each SKU has a single inventory record per warehouse.
